result.description:
## Cyber Security Engineer
## Position Overview
We are looking for an experienced and highly motivated Cyber Security Engineer to join our team and play a critical role in safeguarding our software systems, applications, and digital infrastructure. The successful candidate will be responsible for designing, developing, testing, and maintaining robust security solutions that are fully integrated into our development and operational environments. This role suits a technically adept professional with a strong background in secure software development, vulnerability management, and security architecture who thrives in a collaborative, fast-paced setting.
## Key Responsibilities
- Design, develop, and implement cyber security software applications and systems, ensuring they are fully integrated, well-documented, and aligned with organisational security standards
- Develop and enforce secure coding practices across the software development lifecycle, embedding security controls at every stage from design through to deployment
- Conduct comprehensive security testing, vulnerability assessments, and penetration testing on software, systems, and infrastructure to identify and address potential risks
- Collaborate closely with software developers and engineering teams to identify, prioritise, and remediate security vulnerabilities and coding weaknesses in a timely manner
- Participate in code reviews, offering expert security guidance and ensuring that development teams adhere to established security frameworks and best practices
- Design and maintain secure application programming interfaces (APIs) and libraries for use across software and application environments
- Assess the security posture of third-party software components, open-source libraries, and vendor integrations, providing recommendations to mitigate associated risks
- Perform binary and static code analysis scans on software applications to detect vulnerabilities before release into production environments
- Monitor, analyse, and respond to security incidents and threats across the organisation's systems, networks, and applications
- Develop, maintain, and continuously improve security policies, standards, and documentation to reflect evolving threat landscapes and regulatory requirements
- Support the integration of security tooling and automation into CI/CD pipelines to enable continuous security testing and compliance validation
- Liaise with internal stakeholders, including IT, compliance, and senior leadership, to provide clear reporting on security risks, incidents, and remediation progress
## Required Qualifications & Skills
- Bachelor's degree in Cyber Security, Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related discipline
- Demonstrated experience in a cyber security engineering or information security role, ideally within a complex enterprise environment
- Strong proficiency in secure software development practices and knowledge of common vulnerability frameworks such as OWASP Top 10 and CVSS
- Hands-on experience conducting vulnerability assessments, security testing, and code analysis using industry-standard tools
- Solid understanding of network security, identity and access management, encryption protocols, and security architecture principles
- Experience integrating security controls into DevSecOps and CI/CD pipelines
- Proficiency in one or more programming or scripting languages such as Python, Java, PowerShell, or Bash
- Familiarity with cloud security concepts and platforms, including AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud
- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to assess complex security risks and communicate findings clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills with a collaborative, team-oriented approach
## Preferred Qualifications
- Industry certifications such as CISSP, CEH, OSCP, CompTIA Security+, or equivalent
- Experience working within regulated industries such as finance, healthcare, or government
- Familiarity with Australian Privacy Act requirements, ISO 27001, NIST Cybersecurity Framework, or the Australian Cyber Security Centre (ACSC) Essential Eight
- Exposure to threat modelling methodologies and security risk management frameworks
- Experience with security information and event management (SIEM) platforms and endpoint detection and response (EDR) tools
## Why Join Us?
- Be part of a forward-thinking organisation that places cyber security at the heart of its technology strategy, giving you genuine influence over how security is designed and delivered
- Access ongoing professional development opportunities, including support for industry certifications, training programmes, and conference attendance
- Enjoy a flexible, hybrid working arrangement that supports a healthy work-life balance
- Work within a collaborative and inclusive team culture that values innovation, knowledge sharing, and continuous improvement
- Competitive remuneration package with clear pathways for career progression into senior and leadership roles
## Job Details
- Job Type: Full-time, Permanent
- Work Schedule: 8-hour shift
- Salary: $70,000 – $120,000 per year + Super

About the Role
We are currently seeking an experienced Organisation and Methods Analyst to join our team and lead process improvement and organisational optimisation initiatives. This role is ideal for someone with a keen eye for operational efficiency, systems design, and change management who thrives in dynamic, cross-functional environments.
You will work closely with senior leadership, department heads, and operational teams to evaluate current organisational systems, structures, and methods—proposing changes that drive sustainable growth, resource optimisation, and enhanced service delivery.
Key Responsibilities
Analyse organisational systems, processes, workflows, and structures to identify inefficiencies, redundancies, or compliance issues.
Consult with internal stakeholders to understand existing challenges and gather input on improvement opportunities.
Develop detailed process maps, system diagrams, and documentation to visualise and communicate current state and proposed future state.
Evaluate performance data, reports, and job descriptions to identify gaps, bottlenecks, and risks.
Recommend actionable solutions to improve productivity, restructure workflows, enhance accountability, and support strategic goals.
Prepare and present proposals for changes to procedures, job functions, and resource allocation.
Assist with the implementation of new procedures or organisational structures, including issuing revised manuals and training documentation.
Monitor compliance with new procedures and assess their impact on performance and service outcomes.
Support change management efforts by facilitating stakeholder workshops, coaching team leads, and managing communication plans.
Collaborate with IT and HR teams where technology or staffing intersects with proposed organisational changes.
Essential Skills & Experience
Bachelor’s degree in Business, Commerce, Organisational Development, Industrial Engineering, or related discipline.
Minimum 5 years of experience in business analysis, process improvement, organisational development, or consulting.
Strong capability in mapping and redesigning workflows using tools such as Visio, Lucidchart, or BPMN tools.
Proficiency in gathering, interpreting, and presenting qualitative and quantitative organisational data.
Demonstrated ability to manage stakeholder relationships and facilitate workshops or interviews.
High-level written and verbal communication skills with the ability to translate technical findings into actionable business insights.
Understanding of project management, change management, and continuous improvement methodologies (e.g., Lean, Six Sigma, Agile).
Desirable Qualifications & Certifications
Lean Six Sigma Green/Black Belt Certification
Prosci Change Management Certification
PRINCE2 or PMP Certification
Advanced Excel or Power BI skills for reporting and data analysis
What We Offer
Exposure to high-impact organisational transformation projects
A collaborative team environment that values innovation and insight
Career development opportunities and professional upskilling
Flexible working arrangements and a strong focus on work–life balance

ICBM SERVICES PTY LTD is hiring a Full-time Construction Project Manager role across NSW, WA in Australia. Apply now to be part of our team.

Requirements for this role:

Flexible hours available
2–3 years of relevant work experience required for this role
ICBM SERVICES PTY LTD is looking for an experienced Construction Project Manager for our client’s construction projects, including residential homes, commercial buildings, civil works and public spaces in Sydney.
On a full-time basis, you will be responsible for planning, organising, directing, controlling and coordinating construction projects, as well as managing the physical, financial and human resources involved in the construction process.

Title: Construction Project Manager, Full-time position
Salary: A$ 90,000.00 to 98,000.00 plus super
Work Location: In person
We are looking for applicants who demonstrate the following:

Requirements

•	Bachelor’s degree or higher in Construction Project Management, Construction Management, Building Technology, Building Science, Civil Engineering or another highly relevant field. 
•	At least 2–3 years of relevant experience managing residential, commercial, industrial or civil construction projects. 
•	Demonstrated experience managing construction schedules, budgets, labour, materials, plant and equipment. 
•	Strong knowledge of construction methods, building legislation, Australian Standards, quality requirements and workplace health and safety procedures. 
•	Ability to read, assess and interpret architectural drawings, engineering plans, specifications and construction contracts. 
•	Experience coordinating architects, engineers, consultants, subcontractors, suppliers, tradespeople and relevant authorities. 
•	Strong understanding of tendering, procurement, contract administration and project cost control. 
•	Ability to identify project risks, delays and budget variations and implement appropriate corrective actions. 
•	Strong leadership, communication, negotiation and stakeholder-management skills. 
•	Excellent organisational, reporting and problem-solving abilities. 
•	Current Australian driver licence preferred. 
•	Relevant registration, licence or site accreditation may be required depending on the project and scope of work. 

Construction Project Manager Responsibilities

•	Plan, organise, direct, control and coordinate construction projects from commencement through to completion. 
•	Establish project plans, construction schedules, milestones, budgets and resource requirements. 
•	Interpret architectural drawings, engineering plans, technical specifications and contractual requirements. 
•	Determine appropriate construction methods, sequencing, labour requirements, materials, plant and equipment. 
•	Coordinate the procurement and delivery of construction materials, equipment and services. 
•	Consult with architects, engineers, building professionals, consultants, tradespeople and technical workers. 
•	Negotiate and communicate with building owners, property developers, clients, suppliers and subcontractors. 
•	Prepare, review and contribute to tenders, quotations, contract bids and project proposals. 
•	Implement coordinated work programs across construction sites. 
•	Monitor project progress, expenditure, quality, safety, risk and compliance against approved plans and budgets. 
•	Ensure construction activities comply with relevant building legislation, Australian Standards, contractual requirements and workplace health and safety procedures. 
•	Manage and monitor the performance, quality and progress of contractors and subcontractors. 
•	Arrange the submission of plans, permits and supporting documents to relevant authorities. 
•	Coordinate required inspections, approvals and project handover activities. 
•	Prepare progress reports, budget updates, risk assessments and project documentation. 
•	Identify potential delays, cost overruns, quality issues and construction risks and implement appropriate corrective actions. 
•	Lead and supervise site managers, project engineers, supervisors, forepersons, subcontractors and tradespeople as required. 
•	Maintain effective communication with clients and key stakeholders throughout the construction process. 
•	Ensure projects are completed safely, on time, within budget and in accordance with the required quality standards. 

These responsibilities reflect the official ANZSCO functions for Construction Project Managers, including management of construction schedules, procurement, contractors, budgets, compliance, inspections and project resources. 
If you would like to discuss the role further, please click APPLY and send through an up-to-date CV. We can schedule a time to discuss the position available and determine whether the role is suitable for your qualifications and experience.
Work Location: In person

Geographic Information System (GIS) Analyst

Kogan People Solutions are delighted to be working with a local government powerhouse in Melbourne’s southeast, who wish to appoint a qualified skilled and experienced Geographic Information System (GIS) Analyst.

The newly appointed Geographic Information System (GIS) Analyst will coordinate the collection, maintenance, and reporting of Council’s GIS and spatial databases to ensure a "single source of truth" enhance spatial systems to support business units, optimize data integration for modelling, and deliver GIS training and support across the organization.

Location – Dandenong Vic

Employment Type: Full-time, Ongoing

Salary – Offered in the range $95k to $105k plus superannuation, per annum 

Key Responsibilities of this exciting position include

System Development & Management

•	Platform Administration: Manage and enhance QGIS, IntraMaps, Mapbox, and related spatial systems to expand corporate utility.

•	Integration: Integrate GIS with corporate databases, the Property Information System, and Asset Management Systems to ensure data quality and system functionality.

•	Data Governance: Coordinate spatial data collection (including GPS data) and ensure compliance with external data agreements.
Business Analysis & Reporting

•	Data Interrogation: Utilize GIS and SQL query tools to extract, analyze, and interrogate spatial data for ad-hoc business requirements.

•	Reporting & Presentation: Create, map, and professionally present spatial and textual information for performance reporting and publications.

Customer Support & Vendor Management

•	Support & Training: Provide technical support, document user requests, prepare training materials, and deliver non-technical GIS training to internal staff.

•	Collaboration: Facilitate the bi-monthly GIS User Group and maintain effective working relationships with software vendors and contractors.

At Qantas, our teams come together to create new and unique experiences for our customers 
A fantastic opportunity to lead product design within a squad to deliver world class products for our cabin crew
Full-time permanent position based at our new Product and Innovation Centre in Adelaide   

Join Qantas in our brand-new Product and Innovation Centre located in Adelaide to help meet evolving consumer needs by enabling agile teams to deliver faster, more adaptive solutions that prioritise customer value, continuous feedback, and innovation at every stage of the product lifecycle.

Are you passionate about crafting great mobile experiences? As a Senior Product Designer, you’ll lead the design of mobile tools for our cabin crew, shaping strategy and delivering scalable, high-quality solutions that balance the needs of our people, the business, and the customer experience. If you’re ready to make a real impact, we’d love to hear from you.

You'll be hands-on across the entire product journey—from discovering fresh ideas and digging into research, to shaping the experience and seeing your designs through to launch and ongoing improvement. You'll work closely with Product, Engineering, Operations and Service teams, making sure we deliver seamless, end-to-end experiences for our people and that your design vision stays front and centre from concept to delivery.

You'll set the standard for quality and act as a trusted advisor, guiding your teammates to lift their skills and ways of working. Part of your impact will be making the most of AI-enabled tools to boost insight, creativity, and efficiency—always keeping design judgement, accessibility and our brand in mind. If you love sharing your knowledge and raising the bar for design, we'd love to welcome you aboard!

We're keen to meet designers who are curious and hands-on with AI in their workflow. If you've played around with the latest AI-powered design tools, or have fresh ideas for using AI to spark creativity, speed up prototyping or make delivery smoother, you'll fit right in. Show us how you've used AI to improve your creative process or enhance user outcomes—we're excited to see your practical approach and innovative thinking.

You’ll have:

7+ years of experience in Service Design, UX, UI, CX, and/or a similar role.
Tertiary qualification in Design, Human-Centered Design (HCD), or a relevant field. 
Strong understanding of design for native apps, conversational interfaces, and other digital platforms.
Strategic thinking to deliver innovative outcomes aligned with brief and brand.
Ability to focus on objectives and deliverables at both technical and creative levels,
always user-centric.
Experience developing and promoting a product vision collaboratively.
Experienced in concept development, wireframing, persona creation, user stories and
user testing.
Experience working with design systems and creating user interface.
Proficiency in modern frameworks and rituals: Lean, Design Thinking, Scrum,
Kanban.
Thorough knowledge of usability and accessibility standards, including WCAG 2.0
AA.
Experience using modern industry tools such as Miro, Figma, Lovable, ClaudeCode,
Cursor, and Adobe Creative Suite; collaboration tools like JIRA and Confluence.
Practical experience using AI tools to streamline design handover to developers and
generate code (e.g., Figma's AI plugins, ClaudeCode, Cursor, Lovable).
Advanced logical reasoning and sound decision-making, including numerical
analysis.
Ability to identify and address flawed logic and coach teams to resolve errors. 
Proven ability to solve high-impact design challenges in large, complex
organisations.
Expert facilitation skills, with a track record of successful outcomes.
Inspirational leadership for both direct and remote teams.
Clear communication of design concepts to stakeholders, adapting to the audience.
Extensive knowledge of current digital design standards and industry trends.
Why Qantas?

At Qantas, your career can take you further than you imagined. You’ll join a team where creativity and passion drives success. Together we dream big and deliver even bigger.? 

You’ll find diverse opportunities to grow, personally and professionally. From day one, you’ll be supported with hands-on training, coaching, and formal learning programs designed to help you excel. Your development is our priority because we know that when you thrive, so do our customers. 

And while this role is your starting point at Qantas, it’s just the beginning. We have a proud history of helping our people explore new paths and reach new heights - the destinations are endless. 

The Qantas employee benefits program offers amazing benefits that extend well beyond travel.? 

We love to travel: Enjoy heavily discounted air travel within Australia and across the globe, both for you and your family and friends, as well as exclusive deals on accommodation and holidays. 
We have flexible leave options: Make use of leave and flexible working opportunities including 18 weeks paid parental leave and the option to purchase additional paid leave for eligible employees.  
We’ll give you access to thousands of rewards: Through our partnerships we can offer you discounts across shopping, food and wine, insurance, health and wellbeing, leisure and entertainment.?You can also take advantage of our salary packaging program including motor vehicles, eligible portable electronic devices and professional memberships.  
We’ll support your wellbeing: Whether it’s learning to better support your own and others’ mental health, our interactive wellbeing app or your very own tailored nutrition plan.?
Be a part of something special and play your part in the Qantas story – get in touch today.

In this position, you will gather, process, and interpret data to support strategic decision-making across the organisation. The ideal candidate is highly proficient with data tools and visualisation techniques, communicates findings clearly, and thrives in a collaborative, fast-paced environment.

Key Responsibilities
Establish and maintain secure processes for collecting, storing, processing, and validating data to ensure integrity across all stages of the data lifecycle
Evaluate the accuracy, completeness, and reliability of data from multiple sources, identifying and resolving discrepancies as required
Analyse and interpret complex datasets to produce relevant statistics, identify trends and patterns, and provide data-driven answers to business queries
Apply data analytics and visualisation techniques to uncover actionable insights that support operational and strategic goals
Develop clear, compelling reports, dashboards, and presentations to communicate findings to both technical and non-technical stakeholders
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to understand business requirements and translate them into analytical solutions

Experience with programming languages such as Python or R for data analysis and automation

Ability to interpret and communicate complex data findings clearly to diverse audiences

Experience in an Agile or cross-functional project environment
Industry experience in sectors such as finance, healthcare, retail, or government
